protocol:
Algal culture harvest and RNA extraction for RNA-Seq
Use sterile techniques to harvest 800 ml of culture, and divide into 4 250 ml centrifuge bottles with 200 ml each.
Spin the centrifuge bottles at 5000 g for 10 min.
Carefully decant the supernatant.
Use 0.5 ml of RNALater to resuspend the pellet and transfer it to a microcentrifuge tube.
Use another 0.25 ml of RNALater to wash the bottle and obtain any remaining cells.
Transfer this 0.25 ml into the same microcentrifuge tube.
Depending on whether you want pseudo-replicates, you can keep the 4 harvested pellet separate or mixed.
Store the harvested cells at or below -20oC until ready for RNA extraction.
Before RNA extraction, the RNALater needs to be removed.
Thaw samples if they are frozen.
Centrifuge samples at > 10 k g for 10 min at 4oC.
RNALater sometimes affects the buoyancy of the cells, and make them a bit harder to pellet.
If you find that the cells are not pelleting, spin harder for a longer time.
Decant supernatent with RNALater.
Extract RNA using a RNeasy Plant Mini Kit (Qiagen) following the manufacturer's instructions.
Remove any DNA from the extracted samples using DNase (Sigma), following manufacturer's instructions.
Clean up the total RNA using a RNA Clean & Concentrator kit (Zymo), following the manufacturer's instructions.
Quantify the RNA using any preferred method, e.g. Qubit fluorometer.
Store the RNA at -80oC.
It may be ideal to aliquot some RNA out so that you don't need to thaw the entire RNA sample if you need some for any reason

# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: harvest (container: culture vessel, reagent: algal culture, volume: 800 ml, other: {'sterile_technique': True})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
divide(container='4 x 250 ml centrifuge bottles', reagent='algal culture', volume='200 ml per bottle')
centrifuge(container='centrifuge bottles', volume='200 ml per bottle', duration='10 min', speed='5000 g')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: decant (container: centrifuge bottles, reagent: supernatant, other: {'carefully': True})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
resuspend(container='centrifuge bottle', reagent='RNALater', volume='0.5 ml', target='pellet')
transfer(container='microcentrifuge tube', reagent='resuspended pellet in RNALater', volume='0.5 ml')
wash(container='centrifuge bottle', reagent='RNALater', volume='0.25 ml', target='remaining cells')
transfer(container='microcentrifuge tube', reagent='washed RNALater with cells', volume='0.25 ml')
store(container='microcentrifuge tube', reagent='harvested cells', temperature='-20°C or below', duration='until ready for RNA extraction')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: remove (container: microcentrifuge tube, reagent: RNALater)

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
thaw(container='microcentrifuge tube', reagent='sample', condition='if frozen')
centrifuge(container='microcentrifuge tube', reagent='sample', temperature='4°C', duration='10 min', speed='>10,000 g')
spin(container='microcentrifuge tube', reagent='sample', duration='longer', speed='harder', condition='if cells not pelleting')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: decant (container: microcentrifuge tube, reagent: supernatant with RNALater)
# MANUAL: extract (container: microcentrifuge tube, reagent: RNA, other: {'kit': 'RNeasy Plant Mini Kit (Qiagen)'})
# MANUAL: remove (container: microcentrifuge tube, reagent: DNA, other: {'kit': 'DNase (Sigma)'})
# MANUAL: clean up (container: microcentrifuge tube, reagent: total RNA, other: {'kit': 'RNA Clean & Concentrator kit (Zymo)'})
# MANUAL: quantify (reagent: RNA, other: {'method': 'Qubit fluorometer or other'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
store(reagent='RNA', temperature='-80°C')
aliquot(reagent='RNA', purpose='avoid thawing entire sample')
